Update a project trigger

## Usage

`circleci project trigger update <trigger-id> [flags]`

## Flags

| Flag                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--checkout-ref string` | git ref for checking out code (only when the checkout repo differs from the event source repo)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--config-ref string`   | git ref for fetching config (only when the config repo differs from the event source repo)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--disable`             | pause the trigger without deleting it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--enable`              | resume the trigger so matching events start pipelines                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--event-preset string` | event preset for filtering trigger events (one of: all-pushes, only-tags, default-branch-pushes, only-build-prs, only-open-prs, only-labeled-prs, only-merged-prs, only-ready-for-review-prs, only-branch-delete, only-build-pushes-to-non-draft-prs, only-merged-or-closed-prs, pr-comment-equals-run-ci, non-draft-pr-opened, pushes-to-merge-queues) |
| `--jq string`           | Process values from the response using jq syntax (see `circleci help formatting`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--json`                | Output as JSON                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--project string`      | project slug (e.g. gh/org/repo); only needed for a project's OAuth trigger                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--project-id string`   | project UUID (overrides --project)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Examples

- Pause a trigger without deleting it: 
  `circleci project trigger update a1b2c3d4-... --disable`
- Resume it: 
  `circleci project trigger update a1b2c3d4-... --enable`
- Only build tag pushes, and output the result as JSON: 
  `circleci project trigger update a1b2c3d4-... --event-preset only-tags --json`

## Details

Change an existing trigger. Only the flags you pass are changed. The event
source (provider and repository) is fixed when the trigger is created; to
change it, delete the trigger and create a new one. Run `circleci help triggers`
for what each event preset means.

JSON fields: id, created_at, event_name, event_preset, config_ref, checkout_ref, disabled
